Guwahati_20210416T1300_insat.title: Assam storms, 16 Apr 2021
Guwahati_20210416T1300_insat.description: Issued at 18:30 IST, before the evening storms formed, on INSAT and GFS only (no radar or lightning feed). Checked against real FY-4A satellite lightning: the model beat persistence, and tier 2 gave MODERATE (36 %) for hour 6, the hour the storm reached Guwahati. Skill is modest (CSI about 0.2-0.3).
